<p><strong>Commercial insurance</strong></p>
<p>This is what your cost could be under your health insurance plan. If your plan covers the medication, your insurance will set the cost for your medication. The savings offer through NovoCare® Pharmacy is a discount that may be applied to the amount charged by your insurance.</p>

Wegovy®
Ozempic®
aSelf-pay pricing varies by dose. Patients pay $149 for each month of 1.5 mg, $199 per month for 4 mg and $299 per month for 9 mg and 25 mg. One month defined as 1 bottle of 30 tablets. Eligibility and restrictions apply. Novo Nordisk reserves the right to modify or cancel this program at any time. See full terms at WegovyTerms.com and NovocareDeliveryTerms.com .
bPatients new to the Wegovy® Savings Offer and Novocare® home delivery pay $199 for each month of 0.25 mg and 0.5 mg. Offer is for 2 monthly fills through December 31, 2026, then $349 per month for Wegovy® 0.25 mg, 0.5 mg, 1 mg, 1.7 mg or 2.4 mg and $399 per month for Wegovy® HD (semaglutide) injection 7.2 mg. One month is defined as 1 box of 4 pens of Wegovy®. Eligibility and restrictions apply. Novo Nordisk reserves the right to modify or cancel this program at any time. See full terms at WegovyTerms.com and NovocareDeliveryTerms.com .
cSelf-pay pricing varies by dose. Eligibility and restrictions apply. One month defined as 1 bottle of 30 tablets. Novo Nordisk reserves the right to modify or cancel this program at any time. See full terms at SavingsCardEligibility and NovocareDeliveryTerms.com .
d Patients new to the Ozempic® Savings Offer and Novocare® home delivery pay $199 for each month of 0.25 mg and 0.5 mg. Offer for 2 monthly fills through December 31, 2026 then $349 per month for Ozempic® 0.25 mg, 0.5 mg or 1 mg and $499 per month for Ozempic® 2 mg. One month is defined as 1 box of 1 Ozempic® pen. Novo Nordisk reserves the right to modify or cancel these offers at any time. See full terms at SavingsCardEligibility and NovocareDeliveryTerms.com .
ePay as little as $25, subject to a maximum savings of $100/month. Government beneficiaries excluded. One month is defined as 1 box of 4 pens of Wegovy® and 1 bottle of 30 tablets of Wegovy®. Eligibility and restrictions apply. Novo Nordisk reserves the right to modify or cancel this program at any time. See full terms at WegovyTerms.com and NovocareDeliveryTerms.com .
fPay as little as $25, subject to a maximum savings of $100/month. Eligibility and restrictions apply. One month is defined as 1 box of 1 Ozempic® pen and 1 bottle of 30 tablets of Ozempic®, Novo Nordisk reserves the right to modify or cancel these offers at any time. See full terms at SavingsCardEligibility and NovocareDeliveryTerms.com .
You're closer than you think
Once you select your GLP-1 medicine, follow these steps to get started.
1.
Speak to your prescriber
1.
Speak to your prescriber
A GLP-1 medicine requires a prescription. Talk to your prescriber, or we can connect you with one right here .
2.
Choose how you pay
2.
Choose how you pay
You can self pay or go through insurance.
3.
Get your GLP-1 medicine
3.
Get your GLP-1 medicine
You can choose telehealth, delivery, or pickup—you have options at every step.
Options to get your prescription
Self pay to get your GLP-1 medicine, your way.
Free home delivery
Get your GLP-1 medicine shipped straight to you. Have your prescriber send your prescription to Novocare® and look for your confirmation text.

If it’s not made by Novo, it’s not FDA‑approved Wegovy® or Ozempic®
We know you have a choice, but make it an informed one. Learn about the health risks associated with compound semaglutides on the market.
Your health care professional will determine the prescription and the dose. Always follow the detailed instructions provided by your health care professional.
